name: Confluent Vandermonde Obfuscation
description: Replaced the modular arithmetic pulse condition with the requirement that a specific 3x3 matrix has a non-zero determinant. The matrix is a disguised confluent Vandermonde matrix whose determinant evaluates exactly to (s_u - s_v)^2. This completely hides the simple s_u != s_v inequality behind a layer of symbolic linear algebra, preventing models from recognizing the problem as 3-coloring and applying standard graph-coloring heuristics.
